findings.evidence: The description opens with mechanics ('resolving a live-quota-checked (runtime, model) pair for each task's implementer dispatch (native or external CLI)'). Its WHEN ('when asked to execute or run a superpowers plan that way') only fires when the user names subagent-driven-development. findings.fix: Run a superpowers implementation plan (docs/superpowers/plans/*.md) task by task under superpowers:subagent-driven-development, picking a live-quota-checked (runtime, model) pair for every implementer dispatch, native or an external CLI such as Codex, with quota waits, resume after a stop and a stronger model for fix rounds 4-5. It starts the plan's unit branch before the first task and folds, pushes and readies it after the final review through ai-kit-commit-fold. Use when ai-kit-spec-execute hands over a superpowers plan, when the user asks to run, execute or carry out a superpowers plan or a plan whose header names subagent-driven-development, or wants a per-task model or CLI choice for it, even without naming subagent-driven-development. Not for superpowers:executing-plans (inline, no dispatch point), writing or reviewing a plan, GSD phase execution, or folding a branch on its own (ai-kit-commit-fold).

findings.evidence: references/quota-wake.md is reached only through dispatch-external-cli.md ('MANDATORY: read references/quota-wake.md in full before scheduling or printing a wake'). That is a reference chain two levels deep, and SKILL.md never names the file.
findings.fix: Name it in the quota bullet of SKILL.md Step 3: 'before scheduling or printing the one-shot wake, read references/quota-wake.md in full (Do NOT load it on an owner stop)'.

findings.evidence: 'SKILL_DIR="<Step 0 SKILL_DIR>"; ... CWD="<Step 1 CWD>"; PLAN_FILE="<Step 1 PLAN_FILE>"; TASK_N="<Step 1 TASK_N>"' is typed again from memory for every task. The guard at line 121 catches only empty or placeholder values, not a wrong path, although every later state file and scalar file is keyed off these values.
findings.fix: For every task after the first, run the scalar loader and read SKILL_DIR, SHIM, TOOLS_PY, CWD and PLAN_FILE from the scalar file; type only TASK_N. Keep the literal fill for the first task only.

findings.evidence: The 7 evals cover start, fold and scope (3 of them on fold or start). None exercises the skill's core state branches: a quota_exhausted stop and resume, the one-shot wake after RETURNCODE 75, the escalation floor for rounds 4-5, a pinned stop on real_error, or the trust-local ask. 'precise-external-cli-pair' ships no fixture for the injection.
findings.fix: Add evals with fixture files under evals/files/. (1) A resolve-injection result with mode quota_exhausted and any_quota_recoverable true: assert the state file is written with the quota key dropped and nothing is scheduled. (2) A dispatch result with returncode 75 and whole-number retry_after_s and cycle: assert the pinned injection is re-dispatched and resolve-injection is not called. (3) A round-4 case with ladder A>B anchored on B: assert --escalation-excluded-keys-json carries B and every key below it and is never folded into --exclude-keys-json.

findings.evidence: Every should-trigger query names 'superpowers plan', and most also name 'subagent-driven-development'. Apart from one plan path, none has a file path, a typo or personal context, so no query tests whether the description triggers when the domain is not named.
findings.fix: Replace 3-4 positives with indirect, realistic queries, for example 'ok the plan in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-07-auth.md is approved, kick off the implementation and use codex for the backend tasks if claude quota is low'. Make at least two of them casual or include a typo.

findings.evidence: PROJECT_KEY hashes the raw CWD and PLAN_FILE strings (line 124), and references/start-step.md accepts a PLAN_FILE relative to CWD (cd to CWD, then test -f PLAN_FILE). Followed branch: a re-invoke mid-plan that fills PLAN_FILE in the other form (absolute instead of relative, or the reverse) gets a new SCALARS file and sees RESUME_FOUND=0. Line 107 then records FOLD_BASE at the current HEAD, so Step 5 folds only the commits made after the re-invoke.
findings.fix: Normalize both values before hashing. Right after the guard in the task-paths block and in references/start-step.md, set CWD to its realpath and PLAN_FILE to its realpath resolved against CWD, and state that PLAN_FILE is always absolute. The wake prompt then reads the same form back from plan_path.

findings.evidence: '(block below; new rounds only, never on a resume, a re-invoke that kept its scalars or a Step-2 re-entry, which keep the round and anchor, yet at 4 or more still take the floor below)' packs four cases into one parenthetical. The Schedule-or-stop rule in references/dispatch-external-cli.md lines 182-189 is likewise prose covering five return-code cases.
findings.fix: Replace it with a short decision list. A new fix round: increment FIX_ROUND and set the anchor. A resume, a re-invoke that kept its scalars, or a Step-2 re-entry: keep the round and the anchor. Any of these at round 4 or higher without a pinned injection: apply the escalation floor. Give Schedule-or-stop a five-row case list: 75 with tokens waits; a tokenless 75, a bare 75, any 69, and quota at any other return code are owner stops.
